pairs.summary: Nr2e3 and OSR2 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 4 of 14 profiles analysed (A549 lung adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; SW620 colorectal adenocarcinoma (metastasis); Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Macrophage (General)). Median lift 1.37x, typical spacing ~58 bp between sites. In 3 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
